t: The Photos They Left Behind Made Them a Legend | Bonnie and Clyde (1934)
d:
In 1933 a gang fleeing a police raid left behind rolls of undeveloped film. The frames from that film turned Bonnie and Clyde into a legend. Most of the photographs in this video are the REAL pictures they took of themselves.
